title: Reserve credit for reinsurance.
bodyText: Any dental insurer that takes credit for reserves on risks ceded to a reinsurer shall be subject to provisions of article 4A of chapter 431.
bodyHtml: [§432G-8]  Reserve credit for reinsurance.  Any dental insurer that takes credit for reserves on risks ceded to a reinsurer shall be subject to provisions of article 4A of chapter 431. [L 2013, c 191, pt of §1]
